responsibility: Load, validate and expose all runtime settings: secrets from the environment and tunable parameters from config/parameters.toml. Provides typed parameter objects to every other module so that no numeric constant is ever hard-coded in logic.

public_interface.name: Settings
public_interface.description: Environment-derived settings. Never contains estimation constants.

public_interface.name: AcquisitionConfig
public_interface.description: Rate limiting and funnel configuration for the acquisition stage.

public_interface.name: CoarseFilterCriteria
public_interface.description: Stage-one candidate selection band. Values locked in FORMULATION.md §0 (floor 25, no ceiling so max_review_count is None, 2020-01-01 release-date floor, publisher blocklist instead of a review-count ceiling); none may be defaulted inside code.

public_interface.name: AnalysisParams
public_interface.description: Mirror of FORMULATION.md sections 3a and 6. tag_distance_threshold is None until scripts.freeze_empirical_parameters (ADR-012) computes it from run 1; clustering_linkage is locked to 'average' (FORMULATION.md §6). simplicity_percentile is locked to 0.40 (FORMULATION.md §3a), replacing an earlier max_complexity_score field that implied a fixed absolute threshold rather than a percentile.

public_interface.name: load_settings
public_interface.signature: def load_settings(env_path: Path | None = None) -> Settings
public_interface.description: Reads .env and process environment. Missing STEAM_WEB_API_KEY is not fatal at load time; it is validated by the client that needs it.

public_interface.name: load_parameters
public_interface.signature: def load_parameters(path: Path) -> tuple[AcquisitionConfig, EnrichmentParams, AnalysisParams]
public_interface.description: Parses config/parameters.toml and validates it. Raises ParameterError on any missing key, out-of-range value, or weight set that does not sum to 1.

public_interface.name: parameters_version
public_interface.description: Stable short hash of the parameter file contents, stamped onto every derived row so a score can be traced to the constants that produced it.

public_interface.name: ParameterError
public_interface.description: Raised for any invalid or missing configuration value.

invariants: No estimation constant has a code-level default. A missing key is an error, never a silent fallback -- EXCEPT the two keys FORMULATION.md explicitly locks as optional-by-design: coarse_filter.max_review_count (locked to 'no ceiling', FORMULATION.md §0) and analysis.tag_distance_threshold (locked to 'unset until scripts.freeze_empirical_parameters runs', FORMULATION.md §6). TOML has no null literal, so these two keys are the ONLY ones load_parameters treats a missing key as None for; every other missing key is still ParameterError. This exception list is fixed and hard-coded in load_parameters, not inferred from a field's type annotation.
Weight dictionaries are validated to sum to 1.0 within a small tolerance.
Ratio-valued parameters (storefront_cut, discount_factor, refund_regional_factor) are validated to lie in [0, 1].
edge_cases: parameters.toml missing -> ParameterError with the expected path
parameters.toml present but a genre bucket lacks a multiplier triple -> ParameterError naming the bucket
multiplier triple not monotonically ordered (low <= mid <= high) -> ParameterError
db_path parent directory does not exist -> created on demand by storage, not by config
paths resolved via pathlib only; no hard-coded OS separators (development is Windows, execution may be elsewhere)

unit: load_parameters accepts a complete fixture file and returns populated dataclasses
load_parameters raises ParameterError for each of: missing section, missing key, out-of-range ratio, weights not summing to 1, unordered multiplier triple
parameters_version is stable across reads and changes when any value changes
load_settings falls back to process environment when no .env file exists

non_goals: Does not write or mutate parameters.toml
Does not read FORMULATION.md; the consistency check between the two is a separate startup assertion
open_questions: Should a parameters.toml / FORMULATION.md drift check run at startup and hard-fail, or warn in the UI only?
